questions.prompt: How do spiders differ from insects?
questions.evidenceText: Spiders have eight legs and two main body parts.

questions.prompt: How does a web-building spider find trapped food?
questions.evidenceText: Web-building spiders feel tiny vibrations through their legs.

questions.prompt: Why are spiders useful in gardens?
choices: they eat insects that damage plants
questions.answer: they eat insects that damage plants
questions.evidenceText: They eat many insects, including some that damage plants.
